Subject: Priority lane readout + QBR readying (weekly)

Good morning — weekly snapshot for leadership distro and QBR prep notes. Short, action-oriented.

Wins
- Production rollout of batching optimizer for medium latency tier is live; tail latency down ~14% on p95 for emebdding workloads. Marcus and infra did a great job getting config out without customer-facing churn.
- NimbusHealth pilot completed mirroring tests; inference cost per inference estimated down 18% vs baseline in staging.
- New automated perf-run harness (small/fast jobs) added to CI that catches kernel mis-selection regressions.

Risks / Chokepoints
- SOC2 audit evidence collection: legal needs two missing items (access logs for the KMS key rotation window and sign-off for retention policy). Internal owner: Jonas. Impact: QBR readiness and procurement gating for three enterprise deals if not closed by 11/3.
- Dedicated capacity quotas in eu-west are tight for early November; if we get the two expected bursts from NimbusHealth and CloudBridge, we will exceed soft capacity. Mitigation: short-term borrow from us-west pool + throttle policy. Owner: Marcus.
- A regression in streaming reliability surfaced last night in Canary (5% increase in reconnects). Root cause suspected in retry/backoff change merged last week. Owner: Vanessa.

OKR sync (brief)
- Infra SLOs (KR-2.1): On track — current velocity indicates p95 latency improvement target will be met, but we need to keep batches stable under multimodel traffic.
- Sales/Expansion (KR-3.4): NimbusHealth pilot looks promotable to expansion motion; next step: draft expansion MOU.

Asks (clear owners and dates)
- Jonas: provide the two missing SOC2 evidence artifacts and an attestation email to legal by COB 2026-11-02. Legal will then package for auditor. (Jira: JIRA-OPS-1298)
- Marcus: confirm eu-west burst plan and quota borrow request by EOD 2026-10-28 so we can notify Dedicated customers with potential short throttles.
- Vanessa: triage Canary streaming regression and post interim mitigation steps (rollback flag or tuned backoff) by 2026-10-28 10:00 PT.
- Laura / Leadership: approve the proposed escalation credit cap for NimbusHealth pilot (see slide 6 in attached deck) or confirm alternative by Wednesday 2026-10-29.

Attachments: QBR_prep_slide_deck_v1.pptx (slide 6 has the proposed credit cap), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (working draft).

Quick notes: I will consolidate any approvals/objections into the QBR master deck by Thursday morning. If you want a 15-min pre-send sync, reply with availability (I have 09:00-09:30 PT and 11:30-12:00 PT).

Thanks — KP
